on_screen_text.text: Jody Jones shares the story of his brother Rocky Jones, who was killed by an illegal immigrant after he was released from prison in California.

BROTHER, JONES, WAS MURDERED BY A CRIMINAL ILLEGAL ALIEN. HE WAS SIMPLY AT THE WRONG PLACE AT THE WRONG TIME. THIS MAN WAS ARRESTED, RELEASED, AND WITHIN 24 HOURS HE WENT ON A SHOOTING SPREE IN CENTRAL CALIFORNIA. UNFORTUNATELY, MY BROTHER WAS IN THE WRONG PLACE AT THE WRONG TIME. THIS MAN SHOT MY BROTHER EIGHT TIMES POINT BLANK RANGE. I PRAY THAT NO OTHER FAMILY HAS TO GO THROUGH THAT AND UNFORTUNATELY THEY WILL. AND JUST KNOW, PRESIDENT TRUMP I WANT YOU TO KNOW, NO MATTER WHAT THE FAKE MEDIA SAYS ABOUT YOU, THE AMERICAN PEOPLE LOVE YOU AND WE WILL SUPPORT YOU ALL THE TIME. I'M SICK AND TIRED OF HEARING THESE DEMOCRATIC POLITICIANS STAND UP ON THESE PODIUMS AND SAY HOW SORRY THEY ARE FOR SEEING THESE CRIMINAL ILLEGAL ALIENS BEING RIPPED APART FROM THEIR FAMILIES. WHAT ABOUT US? WHAT ABOUT THE AMERICAN FAMILY? WHAT ABOUT US? WE MEAN SOMETHING TOO. AND THIS MAN RIGHT HERE UNDERSTANDS IT.

spoken_summary: Jody Jones tells the story of his brother, Rocky Jones, who he says was murdered by an undocumented immigrant in California. He claims the perpetrator was released from prison and went on a shooting spree within 24 hours, killing his brother. He then addresses Donald Trump directly, praising him and telling him that "the American people love you" despite what the "fake media" says. Jones criticizes "Democratic politicians" for caring more about immigrant families than American families, asking "What about us?", and concludes that Trump is the one who understands their pain.
audio_music: The audio consists solely of Jody Jones's speech, delivered in a clear and increasingly emotional voice. Applause from an unseen audience can be heard after he praises Trump.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot of the speaker and Donald Trump at a podium. The only editing is the addition of a persistent text overlay at the top and large, dynamic, word-by-word captions that transcribe the speech.
central_claim: Lenient immigration policies favored by Democrats are causing violent deaths of American citizens, and Donald Trump is the only leader who understands and supports the victims' families.
intended_effect: To create anger toward undocumented immigrants and the Democratic Party, evoke sympathy for the victim's family, and build support for Donald Trump as a protective leader.
